waves.name: Main job and its dispatcher
waves.rationale: The tree is one job, one step and two programs, so it is one wave. HIDDEN01 rides with PGMMAIN because the computed call at line 9 may name it, and a port that drops it could break a call nobody can see. This is not a low-risk first wave: PGMMAIN is high-high, so the wave is ported behind a facade and only after the target set is known.
waves.unblocks: Running the main job off the legacy platform, and a bounded list of the programs PGMMAIN can dispatch to, which the client does not have today.
